field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable the Wildcard Aliases DNS forwarder (wildcardaliasesd).

field.label: Listen addresses
field.help: Addresses (ip:port or [ipv6]:port) to accept DNS queries on, for example 127.0.0.1:5354. Point the resolver that serves your clients at this address, either for all queries (recommended, e.g. AdGuard Home upstream 127.0.0.1:5354) or only for the watched domains (Unbound "Query Forwarding", or an AdGuard Home per-domain upstream like [/core.windows.net/]127.0.0.1:5354).

field.label: Upstream servers
field.help: Servers that actually resolve the queries, tried in order. They must not forward the watched domains back to Wildcard Aliases (loop). With AdGuard Home in front of Unbound, use Unbound's address (for example 127.0.0.1:5353).

field.label: Minimum hold time
field.help: Learned addresses stay in their table for at least this many seconds, even if the DNS TTL is shorter.

field.label: Grace period
field.help: Seconds added to the DNS TTL, covering clients and caches that keep using an answer slightly longer.

field.label: Maximum hold time
field.help: Upper bound in seconds, regardless of the TTL announced by the upstream.

field.label: Failure mode
field.help: What to do with an answer for a watched domain when its table cannot be updated. "Closed" makes the lookup fail, which is the right choice when the table is used to allow traffic.
